integrity: Exact graph recursion and algebraic inequality are proved; finite checks are diagnostic. No unsupported physical order parameter or independence claim is made.
scientific_limitations: The product condition is a sharp uniform sufficient criterion, not an exact critical surface for each periodic profile. Only two-root connectivity is proved, not giant-component density or cluster critical exponents. Literature priority remains provisional pending independent external assessment.
title: A sharp geometric-mean connectivity criterion for periodically decorated hierarchical flowers
